what_this_build_carries: Elliott's four asks from the post-scooter-rider playtest: the timer is two minutes shorter on every difficulty; Ellison yells and the screen flashes red when he is attacked; stepping off the bike faces him down the route.

sweep.note: Ran against the packaged executable, not the editor, so this also proves the cooked data table carries the new timers.

BattleMurderKAudit.note: The cooked DT_Difficulty answers timer=90 for Easy, and the audit's 90/60/30 family check passes, which is the cook-side proof that the trim shipped rather than only landing in the CSV.

BattleTimeAudit.verdict: BattleTimeAudit: {"passed":true,"phase":4,"reason":"Actual bonus layout, single collection, bike/foot clock, live pistol/shotgun rewards and penalties, miss and ended-run guards pass","time_pickups":3}

BattleTroubleAudit.note: Three hurt takes resolve through LoadObject in the cooked build, the component plays, and the damage flash is set to the full 0.45 s. The audit's stage 0 also lifts the run clock, because its no-player time (a crash, a -60 police shot, two -10 tasers) could otherwise spend the whole 90 s Easy budget and make the stage-7 assertion unreachable.

BattleFootAudit.note: Body and camera agree with the route heading after a dismount, which is the whole point of the change.

BattlePatioAudit.note: The whole-course drive, and the audit the timer trim could most easily have broken: it walks the authored route under what is now a 90 s Easy budget and still commits the win.
